description: Record the screen of the iOS Simulator or Android device (start, do the steps, stop). On stop, saves an MP4 plus a viewer page that plays it beside a timeline of what the app did (web calls, query fetches, route changes, store writes, console errors) and what you did (your taps and other actions), and returns a short written summary. Real touches (native_tap, native_swipe, native_pinch) show as marks on the video, and with ffmpeg installed a copy of the MP4 has them drawn in. In .buoy/recordings. Use it to show a bug or a fix, e.g. for a pull request. Max 3 minutes. To record a set of taps or swipes, pass them as steps with start: Buoy records, runs them with real touches, stops and saves, all in one call.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name.description: start: a short name for the files, e.g. "checkout-timeout".

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

steps.description: start: run_flow steps to record, e.g. [{tap:"One"},{tap:"Two"}]. Taps and swipes are real touches, so they show on the video. Each tap waits for its target, so no waitMs is needed between taps. The video stops and saves when they finish; no stop call needed.

items.description: One flow step. Order within a step: reload → tap/type/set/swipe → waitMs → waitFor/waitGone → expect.

expect.description: Assert an element matching this IS on screen (waits up to 2s for it); fails the flow if not.

expectGone.description: Assert nothing matches this (waits up to 2s for it to go); fails the flow if something does.

into.description: Target text input for `type`: testID or fuzzy text.

maxChange.description: snapshot: allowed changed share of the screen, in percent. Default 0.05.

real.description: Make this step's tap a real touch. Default: the flow's `real`.

reload.description: Reload the JS bundle before this step's action.

set.description: Set a toggle (true/false) or slider (number) — pair with `tap` as the target.

snapshot.description: Compare the whole screen to the baseline with this name (saved on the first run, like screenshot_component baseline). Fails the step on a text change or a change bigger than maxChange.

swipe.description: A real swipe, the way the finger moves: "up" scrolls down the list.

tap.description: Tap this element: exact testID, or fuzzy visible text.

timeoutMs.description: Budget for this step's waitFor/waitGone/expect, max 60000. Default 5000 (2000 for expect).

untilEnd.description: With swipe: keep swiping until the screen stops moving (the end of the list).

waitFor.description: Wait until an element matching this appears (default 5s).

waitGone.description: Wait until no element matches this (default 5s).

waitMs.description: Fixed pause after the action, in ms (max 30000). To wait for a result (a slow request, a new screen), use waitFor with timeoutMs instead: it stops as soon as the element shows.

name: screen_recording
